title: System Monitor Sensor widget presets don't permit some title characters, but the "Save Settings as Preset" button gives no feedback whether it succeeded or failed
line: Saving a System Monitor widget as a preset now works with any title and shows a message saying whether it worked.
explanation: SensorFaceController::savePreset() built the preset's package id from the title with only spaces removed. KPackage refuses ids with anything but letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.', so a title like "CPU / RAM" made the install fail; the error only went to the journal and the button gave no feedback either way. The change keeps only accepted characters in the id (falling back to "preset" if none are left; the shown name is still the full title), and the controller now reports the install result, which the Appearance page shows in an inline message.

commits.message:
faces: Save presets with any title and show whether saving worked

The preset id was the title with only spaces removed, so titles with
characters like "/" gave an id KPackage refuses and nothing happened.
Keep only the characters it accepts and say whether saving worked.
